svg.title: CPU accounting scopes
svg.desc: Mode 2 median CPU per both-direction payload byte. Endpoint and outer-task scopes overlap and must not be added. Outer-task CPU includes KVM halt polling and a small control interval. Neither scope is all-machine or transport-only CPU.
